questions.s:
The correct answer is: a
  • 34 5 + 21 = 191
  • 56 5 + 21 = 301

63 5 + 21 = 336

In a certain code language, 'so it be' is written as 'lor kor nor', 'it is done' is written as 'zor kor tor', and 'be yourself ' is written as 'nor xor'. How will 'so' be written in that language?

एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में, 'so it be' को 'lor kor nor' के रूप में लिखा गया है, 'it is done' को 'zor kor tor' के रूप में लिखा गया है और 'be yourself ' को 'nor xor' के रूप में लिखा गया है। समान भाषा में 'so' किस प्रकार लिखा जाएगा?
questions.s:
'so it be' is written as 'lor kor nor' ----I

'it is done' is written as 'zorkor tor'----II

'be yourself ' is written as 'nor xor' ---III

From I and II, 'it' is written as 'kor'

From I and III, 'be' is written as 'nor'.

So, the remaining word 'so' is written as 'lor'.
